mostWorthwhile.text: Following the sample through filtration and recovery was most worthwhile. The results distinguished what stays in the blood from what enters the tubule, then showed useful substances and water returning to blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but predictable; the named slots made those choices mainly assembly steps.

surprise.text: The recovery result added that healthy kidneys normally reclaim almost all filtered glucose, making the purpose of the tubule transporters clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The item titles and results gave each combination a clear purpose in either the drainage route or the filtering sequence.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it builds on these systems with a new relationship or a less predictable decision. This chapter's explanations were clear, though most combinations were easy to anticipate.
